title: Plasma Bunny City
description: A glowing plasma globe with pink, blue, and yellow electrical tendrils sits in the foreground, its glass sphere containing a painted city skyline with bridges at night. Behind it is a large stylized anime girl with bunny ears, colorful hair, and big eyes, set against a vibrant, painterly background with dripping flowers and abstract shapes.
prompt: A surreal digital painting featuring a large plasma globe in the foreground with bright pink, blue and yellow electrical arcs inside, containing a painted night city skyline with bridges. Behind the globe is a large stylized anime girl with colorful rainbow hair, big sparkling eyes and prominent bunny ears, set against a dreamy purple and orange sky with dripping flowers and abstract paint splashes in a vibrant street art style.
